senses.definition_vi: hành động chính thức thông báo điều gì đó cho mọi người

senses.definition: children of your own

examples.x: He died without issue.

senses.definition_vi: con cái của chính bạn

senses.definition: to be the most important part of the subject that is being discussed

examples.x: What is at issue is whether she was responsible for her actions.

senses.definition_vi: là phần quan trọng nhất của chủ đề đang được thảo luận

senses.definition: to do something to make people take a decision quickly
senses.definition_vi: làm điều gì đó để mọi người đưa ra quyết định nhanh chóng

senses.definition: to start disagreeing or arguing with somebody about something

examples.x: I must take issue with you on that point.

senses.definition_vi: bắt đầu bất đồng hoặc tranh cãi với ai đó về điều gì đó

senses.definition: to make something known formally

examples.x: They issued a joint statement denying the charges.
to issue an apology
a report issued by the Department for Education
A warning was issued yesterday by the government, asking people to stay in their homes.
The president has the authority to issue orders to the military.
The new guidelines have been issued to all doctors.

senses.definition_vi: chính thức công bố điều gì đó

senses.definition: to give something to somebody, especially officially

examples.x: to issue a licence/certificate/permit/ticket
The authorities refused to issue him a visa.
New members will be issued with a temporary identity card.
Work permits were issued to only 5% of those who applied for them.

senses.definition_vi: cung cấp cho ai đó, đặc biệt là một cách chính thức

senses.definition: to start a legal process against somebody, especially by means of an official document

examples.x: to issue a writ against somebody
A warrant has been issued for his arrest.

senses.definition_vi: bắt đầu một quy trình pháp lý chống lại ai đó, đặc biệt là bằng một văn bản chính thức

senses.definition: to produce something such as a magazine, article, etc.

examples.x: We issue a monthly newsletter.

senses.definition_vi: sản xuất một cái gì đó như một tạp chí, bài báo, v.v.

senses.definition: to produce new stamps, coins, shares, etc. for sale to the public

examples.x: They issued a special set of stamps to mark the occasion.
newly issued banknotes

senses.definition_vi: sản xuất tem, tiền xu, cổ phiếu mới, v.v. để bán cho công chúng

senses.definition: the study and use of electronic processes and equipment to store and send information of all kinds, including words, pictures and numbers (the abbreviation for ‘information technology’)

examples.x: the increasing use of IT in all aspects of today's society
I've worked in IT for 30 years.
IT professionals/staff/managers
the IT industry/sector
an IT company/department
IT infrastructure/security

senses.definition_vi: nghiên cứu và sử dụng các quy trình và thiết bị điện tử để lưu trữ và gửi thông tin dưới mọi hình thức, bao gồm từ ngữ, hình ảnh và số (viết tắt của ‘information technology’)

senses.definition: used to refer to an animal or a thing that has already been mentioned or that is being talked about now

examples.x: ‘Where's your car?’ ‘It's in the garage.’
Did you see it?
The other room has two beds in it.
Look! It's going up that tree.
We have $500. Will it be enough for a deposit?

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để chỉ một động vật hoặc một vật đã được đề cập trước đó hoặc hiện đang được nói đến

senses.definition: used to refer to a baby, especially one whose sex is not known

examples.x: Her baby's due next month. She hopes it will be a boy.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để chỉ một em bé, đặc biệt là em bé chưa biết giới tính

senses.definition: used to identify a person

examples.x: It's your mother on the phone.
Hello, Peter, it's Mike here.
Hi, it's me!
Was it you who put these books on my desk?

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để xác định một người

senses.definition: used in the position of the subject of a verb when you are talking about time, the date, distance, the weather, etc.

examples.x: It's ten past twelve.
It's our anniversary.
It's two miles to the beach.
It's a long time since they left.
It was raining this morning.
It's quite warm at the moment.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng ở vị trí chủ ngữ của động từ khi bạn đang nói về thời gian, ngày tháng, khoảng cách, thời tiết, v.v.

senses.definition: used to refer to a fact or situation that is already known or happening

examples.x: When the factory closes, it will mean 500 people losing their jobs.
Yes, I was at home on Sunday. What about it? (= Why do you ask?)
Stop it—you're hurting me!

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để chỉ một sự thật hoặc tình huống đã biết hoặc đang xảy ra

senses.definition: used in the position of the subject or object of a verb when the real subject or object is at the end of the sentence

examples.x: Does it matter what colour it is?
It's impossible to get there in time.
It's no use shouting.
She finds it boring at home.
It appears that the two leaders are holding secret talks.
I find it strange that she doesn't want to go.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng ở vị trí chủ ngữ hoặc tân ngữ của động từ khi chủ ngữ hoặc tân ngữ thực sự ở cuối câu

senses.definition: used when you are talking about a situation

examples.x: If it's convenient I can come tomorrow.
It's good to talk.
I like it here.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn đang nói về một tình huống

senses.definition: used to emphasize any part of a sentence

examples.x: It's Jim who's the clever one.
It's Spain that they're going to, not Portugal.
It was three weeks later that he heard the news.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh bất kỳ phần nào của câu

senses.definition: exactly what is needed

examples.x: In this business, either you've got it or you haven't.

senses.definition_vi: chính xác những gì cần thiết

senses.definition: this/that is the important point, reason, etc.

examples.x: That's just it—I can't work when you're making so much noise.

senses.definition_vi: đây/đó là điểm, lý do, v.v. quan trọng

senses.definition: this/that is the end

examples.x: I'm afraid that's it—we've lost.

senses.definition_vi: đây/đó là kết thúc

senses.definition: the expected event is just going to happen

examples.x: Well, this is it! Wish me luck.

senses.definition_vi: sự kiện dự kiến sắp xảy ra

senses.definition: this is the main point

examples.x: ‘You're doing too much.’ ‘Well, this is it. I can't cope with any more work.’

senses.definition_vi: đây là điểm chính

senses.definition: one thing on a list of things to buy, do, talk about, etc.

examples.x: What's the next item on the agenda?
There are plenty of vegetarian items on the menu.
She still has five items on her to-do list.
Students had to select three topics from the list of items.
There is a maximum score of two points per test item.

senses.definition_vi: một thứ trong danh sách những thứ cần mua, làm, nói về, v.v.

senses.definition: a single object or thing

examples.x: Can I pay for each item separately?
The price of many basic food items continues to rise.
household items such as brushes and bedclothes
A windproof jacket is an essential item of clothing for hillwalking.
Are there any items of furniture you want to take with you?
The computer was my largest single item of expenditure.
This clock is a collector's item (= because it is rare and valuable).

senses.definition_vi: một đối tượng hoặc vật thể duy nhất

senses.definition: a single piece of news in a newspaper, on television, online, etc.

examples.x: The following news item may be of interest to you.
I heard an item on the radio about a new cancer treatment.
I came across two items of disturbing news.
The Journal is packed with items of interest from cover to cover.

senses.definition_vi: một mẩu tin tức duy nhất trên báo, truyền hình, trực tuyến, v.v.

senses.definition: to be involved in a romantic or sexual relationship

examples.x: Are they an item?

senses.definition_vi: để có liên quan đến một mối quan hệ lãng mạn hoặc tình dục

senses.definition: belonging to or connected with a thing, an animal or a baby

examples.x: Turn the box on its side.
Have you any idea of its value?
The dog had hurt its paw.
The baby threw its food on the floor.

senses.definition_vi: thuộc về hoặc liên quan đến một vật, một con vật hoặc một em bé

senses.definition: used when the animal or thing that does an action is also affected by it

examples.x: The cat was washing itself.
Does the computer turn itself off?
The company has got itself into difficulties.
There's every reason for the team to feel proud of itself.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi con vật hoặc vật thực hiện một hành động cũng bị ảnh hưởng bởi nó

senses.definition: used to emphasize an animal, a thing, etc.

examples.x: The village itself is pretty, but the surrounding countryside is rather dull.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh một con vật, một vật, v.v.

senses.definition: to be an example of complete patience, etc.

examples.x: The manager of the hotel was courtesy itself.

senses.definition_vi: là một ví dụ về sự kiên nhẫn hoàn chỉnh, v.v.

senses.definition: automatically; without anyone doing anything

examples.x: The machine will start by itself in a few seconds.

senses.definition_vi: tự động; mà không ai làm bất cứ điều gì

senses.definition: alone

examples.x: The house stands by itself in an acre of land.

senses.definition_vi: một mình

senses.definition: considered separately from other things; in its true nature

examples.x: In itself, it's not a difficult problem to solve.

senses.definition_vi: được xem xét tách biệt với những thứ khác; trong bản chất thực của nó

senses.definition: for only it to have or use; not shared with others

examples.x: The company doesn't have the market to itself.

senses.definition_vi: chỉ để nó có hoặc sử dụng; không chia sẻ với người khác

senses.definition: that cannot exist or be done; not possible

examples.x: almost/virtually/nearly impossible
Only a year ago this would have seemed impossible.
Getting any kind of decent job was proving impossible.
an impossible dream/goal
Going downstairs would be impossible for him with his sprained ankle.
The outcome is impossible to predict.
It's impossible to prove.
Cheap rental accommodation was impossible to find.

examples.cf: it is impossible to do something
examples.x: It's impossible to say which is the best.
It is impossible to tell whether it will actually work.
I find it impossible to lie to her.

examples.cf: it is impossible for somebody to do something
examples.x: It's impossible for me to be there before eight.

senses.definition_vi: không thể tồn tại hoặc được thực hiện; không thể

senses.definition: very difficult to deal with

examples.x: I've been placed in an impossible position.
Honestly, you're impossible at times!

senses.definition_vi: rất khó để xử lý

senses.definition: a thing that is or seems impossible

examples.x: to attempt the impossible

senses.definition_vi: một điều gì đó là hoặc có vẻ không thể

senses.definition: a difficult or impossible task

examples.x: Many regard this task as mission impossible.

senses.definition_vi: một nhiệm vụ khó khăn hoặc bất khả thi
